packageRules.description: The plugin SDK must match the pluginsdk version of the Kandev release that runs in production (kandev v0.103.x = pluginsdk v0.4.0). Bump it only together with the Kandev upgrade in skbki/argo-m2: approve from the Dependency Dashboard, never merge on its own.
The Go toolchain (go directive) follows the version Kandev's pluginsdk requires; review with the SDK bump.
GitHub Actions: one weekly PR, digest-pinned (config:best-practices).
Other Go modules (grpc, protobuf, x/crypto ...): minor and patch updates grouped into one weekly PR.
